scope: exploratory new-passage development; no final confirmation
lora_targets: all 36 up projections; stronger parameter budget than row controls
preservation_replay: one actual baseline-correct calibration trajectory per adaptation step, equal example loss weights
selection: norm of mean calibration weight gradient after input-span projection; 32 per fixed layer

promotion_criteria.comparison: projected candidate should improve the unprotected-row and LoRA correction/preservation trade-off; all settings reported
promotion_criteria.status: exploratory promotion criteria, not a broad superiority claim

selection_rule: within each family choose validation balanced EM maximum among settings retaining at least 95% baseline-correct supported answers; otherwise report Pareto settings; lower LR breaks ties. Utility does not select hyperparameters.
adaptation_pool: 128 training-source rows plus all 32 discovery/calibration rows, same unique labels for every family
anchor_policy: baseline-exact non-refusal supported responses; distinct articles, length then ID; actual generated token trajectories
